title: Attacker-controlled iteration exceeds the effective work budget
preconditions: Peer-controlled traversal, skipping or result construction may perform more work than a visible result limit suggests
dangerous_transitions: Peer-controlled traversal, skipping or result construction may perform more work than a visible result limit suggests
sink_semantics: iteration, filtering, pagination or materialization of results
counterevidence: Indexed access or bounded traversal limits work before processing attacker-selected ranges.
Enforced admission, time and aggregate resource budgets prevent availability impact at the declared concurrency.
verification_recipe: Trace the language-specific source cue to iteration, filtering, pagination or materialization of results.
Establish attacker control, effective principal, guarding order, and security impact.
Test the stated language-specific counterevidence against source and runtime behavior.
